<description>
We've had a handful of dead code removal PRs over the last month or two:

* #35679
* #35910
* #35914
* #35971
* #36009
* #36012
* #36103
* #36127
* #36509

Also well as an instance of what was thought to be dead code, but it'd just been forgotten to be used: #36137.

It could be beneficial to get `-Wunused` enabled, to catch dead/unused code in CI.

Enabling some of these flags may also help enforce other stuff, like `inline constexpr` usage (#35852). i.e:
```bash
  /home/runner/work/_temp/src/leveldb/db/dbformat.h:67:29: error: 'leveldb::kMaxSequenceNumber' defined but not used [-Werror=unused-const-variable=]
     67 | static const SequenceNumber kMaxSequenceNumber = ((0x1ull << 56) - 1);
        |                             ^~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~~
```

Based on:
* https://github.com/bitcoin-core/minisketch/pull/104
</description>

5f9e7b2cbc [[nomerge]] minisketch: unused changes

7e7eb3514c refactor: fix -Wunused issues

e563664025 build: add -Wunused
</commits>
